agent_notes: The supplied NIRF College and Overall 2025 pages both contain the exact institution name with CHHATARPUR, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS requests failed with the managed-network proxy error `SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain`; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected NIRF, search, and mcbu.ac.in hosts.
The official homepage, About University page, and Contact Us page consistently identify the Chhatarpur campus at Police Lines Road, Panna Road, Chhatarpur (M.P.) 471001.

The dedicated official pages expose 27 undergraduate specialization rows, 20 postgraduate specialization rows, 19 Ph.D. subject rows, 7 diploma rows, and 7 certificate rows. The official admission Course Details page additionally shows B.B.A. and Physical Education programme-family tabs, so those families are included without invented specializations.

Catalogue completeness remains unresolved: the admission Course Details page has empty detailed tables for its programme-family tabs, and the separate UTD Vocational Courses page is labelled Session 2023-24 while appearing under the 2025-26 admission timeline. Its 12 vocational entries were not imported as degree, diploma, certificate, or doctoral programmes because their credential and current active status are not established. Manual review is required before publishing the catalogue.

Duration values for undergraduate and postgraduate families come from the official Course Details admission page; Ph.D. duration and eligibility are not stated on the official Ph.D. catalogue page and remain null.
